summary: Contractor reimbursement batch: partial failures due to EU IBAN normalization change
summary_long: Multiple contractor reimbursements in payout batch #2026-03-10-17 failed with 'invalid beneficiary account' errors after we deployed an IBAN normalization regexp change Friday evening.
description:
Issue summary:
On 2026-03-10 at 17:05 UTC the daily contractor reimbursement job (payout batch id: 2026-03-10-17) reported 12 failures out of 342 payments for EU contractors. Bank returned 'invalid beneficiary account' for 8 of those and 4 were marked as 'returned - routing mismatch' an hour later. The failures started immediately after a small change to the IBAN normalizer regexp shipped in release r-infra-payments@2.18.0.

Impact:
- 8 EU contractors did not receive funds; 4 payments are in returned/reclaim state.
- Finance is blocked from closing the March 10 payroll reconciliation for contractor payments.
- Customer-facing impact: contractors have emailed ops, some flagged as high-priority (external partner engagements).

Environment:
- prod-us-east payments cluster (k8s payments-prod v4.3)
- Payout processor: pay-facade v1.12 -> bank-gateway service v3.6
- Release that coincides: r-infra-payments@2.18.0 deployed 2026-03-10 16:58 UTC

Steps to reproduce:
1) Run payout job using batch id 2026-03-10-17 against staging dataset with the same contractor records (sanitized).
2) Observe bank-gateway logs filter for "iban_normalizer" and "validate_account" calls.
3) For a sample affected IBAN (redacted: DE** **** **** **** **** **), validate behavior before and after applying regexp change.

Observed logs (snippets):
- bank-gateway: ERROR validate_account: beneficiary validation failed: invalid_bban_format (account=DE**...)
- pay-facade: WARNING payout-worker: payment-scheduled but bank_rej_code=IBAN_FMT

Attachments/links:
- Slack thread: #finance-payments "contractor-payout-fails" (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C05PAY/2026-03-10)
- Deploy PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/payments/pull/412 (regexp tweak for IBAN)
- Payment logs: s3://redwood-logs/payments/2026/03/10/17/batch-2026-03-10-17.log
steps_taken:
- Rolled back r-infra-payments@2.18.0 to 2.17.4 on 2026-03-10 18:10 UTC; immediate reduction in new failures observed for subsequent mini-batch.
- Manually validated 3 sample IBANs using older normalizer; they passed.
- Opened CHAPS/SWIFT inquiry with acquiring bank for returned items (case #BANK-7743).
- Isolated 12 affected payout entries and flagged them for manual resend after confirmation of corrected formatting.
investigation_notes:
Hypothesis: the new regexp aggressively strips out certain separators and zero-padding in niche country BBAN layouts (DE/AT/NL variants), changing canonicalized account string that the acquiring bank uses for checksum/validation.
Evidence:
- Timing correlation with deploy 16:58 UTC.
- Unit tests for standard IBANs passed; edge-case IBANs from contractor CSV (exported from payroll legacy) appear to contain non-printing unicode (U+202F narrow no-break space) that the new normalizer removed earlier than the older version, changing field lengths.
- Bank gateway validation logs show the normalized string length mismatch for flagged accounts.

Next steps recommended:
1) Revert regexp in master (done) and add strict unit tests for narrow no-break space and other unicode whitespace.
2) Run repair job to re-normalize affected accounts using the older normalizer then resend payments.
3) Add monitoring alert: if post-deploy payout failure rate > 1% for two consecutive batches, auto-create INT and roll back candidate.

Permanent fix: merged PR #418 to master to add edge-case unicode whitespace handling and expanded IBAN test vectors; scheduled for next safe deploy window (2026-03-15).
